ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Caution
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is exceptionally cautious of their surroundings, and is better able to detect stealthed enemies, remain hidden in stealth themselves, and is less likely to trigger enemy traps.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Improved Caution
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is exceptionally cautious of their surroundings, and is better able to detect stealthed enemies, remain hidden in stealth themselves, and is less likely to trigger enemy traps. Replaces Caution.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Master Caution
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is exceptionally cautious of their surroundings, and is better able to detect stealthed enemies, remain hidden in stealth themselves, and is less likely to trigger enemy traps. Replaces Improved Caution.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Second Wind
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Utilize this pawn's unshakable fighting spirit to attempt to revive themself while downed.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Improved Second Wind
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Utilize this pawn's unshakable fighting spirit to attempt to revive themself while downed, or encourage an incapacitated nearby ally to get back up. Replaces Second Wind.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Master Second Wind
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Utilize this pawn's unshakable fighting spirit to attempt to revive themself and any nearby incapacitated allies while downed. Can also target a small group of incapacitated allies without the caster needing to be downed themself. Replaces Improved Second Wind.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Toughness
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is built sturdier than most, and is better able to withstand the effects of pain and bodily damage.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Improved Toughness
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is built sturdier than most, and is better able to withstand the effects of pain and bodily damage. Replaces Toughness.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Master Toughness

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Conditioning
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: This pawn is adapted to working in harsh conditions. They are better able to withstand environmental extremes, cope with stress, and survive longer without adequate food or rest.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Precise Shot
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Utilize this pawn's sharp senses to grant them greatly increased ranged accuracy and damage for three seconds.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Improved Precise Shot
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Utilize this pawn's sharp senses to grant them greatly increased ranged accuracy and damage for three seconds. Replaces Precise Shot.

ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.label: Dual Strike
ItsSorceryFramework.LearningTreeNodeDef.description: Train this pawn to utilize teamwork while attacking enemies, giving them a bonus to shooting and melee accuracy when other colonists are within one tile of them while drafted.
